text_block_list.name: Messiah & Craft
text_block_list.text:
—I won't back down...! —I don't wanna 
lose!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, amazing!! Ah, it's so hot...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: But!! I will... lead!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Holy crap, this is insane!! This Triple 
Tiara prelude... wait, it's basically the 
real deal already!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... that totally woke me up!! This 
year's Tiara route looks super exciting! I 
gotta memorize everyone's names...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more. Just a little more and 
I'll be... in there too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...All right. With these legs as my 
weapon... on to the Oka Sho—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Just a bit more... Eliminate those missed 
opportunities. If I do that... then at the 
Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh... Racing really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If she's this good in a prep race, then 
the Oka Sho will be even more...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there such a thing as a time 
machine!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run the Oka Sho right now! I 
mean, wouldn't you!?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft with her magnificent speed, and 
Messiah steadily eyeing the lead with her 
stable running...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, we even have Cesario here, 
with her unbelievable late-race sprint, 
you know?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt that's gonna turn into 
one fiery race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If I can conquer the clash against 
everyone and become the queen—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how amazing that would 
feel!?
choice_data_list:
I still have a lot more growing to do 
before I can feel that.

I still need to grow a bit more before I 
can feel that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… That's true. I can't just be excited 
the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. I didn't need a time 
machine after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's head out only after steadily growing 
stronger on these legs!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...I'll win. I'll win, and――"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become a dream Tiara 
Umamusume. Starting with the Oka Sho—!
